name: Two-Handed Blade Technique (Combat)
body:
You have learned blindingly fast two-handed sword techniques.

Prerequisite(s): Weapons of the duelist

Benefit(s): You may use any swordlord guardian ability, or ability restricted to using a dueling sword in one hand, with a two-handed weapon that otherwise would not be allowed. The two-handed weapon is still required to be a finesse weapon by property or by taking the Diverse Dueling Blades feat from this book.
